hero.title: A peaceful journey,
hero.zhLine: 慈悲 · 庄严 · 安详
hero.paragraph: Singapore Buddhist Funeral Services provides dignified Buddhist funerals — honouring your loved one with proper rites, mindful care and a serene farewell, available around the clock.

strip.text: Immediate assistance, day or night — our advisors will guide you through every step.

steps.title: When a loved one
steps.lead: In the first hours, you do not need to face the arrangements alone. Call us first — we will handle everything that follows.

items.title: Call Us First
items.text: Contact our 24-hour hotline. Our advisor will guide you calmly through what needs to be done, wherever the passing occurred.

items.title: Certification of Death
items.text: We assist with the doctor's Certificate of Cause of Death (CCOD) and the official death documentation required in Singapore.

items.title: Bringing Them Home
items.text: Our team transfers your loved one with care to the wake venue — void deck, funeral parlour or your home — and prepares the setup.

items.title: The Wake & Rites Begin
items.text: We arrange the altar, casket and monk chanting rites, so your family can focus on being present with one another.

services.title: Our
services.lead: A full Buddhist funeral service, arranged end to end — every detail handled with reverence.

items.title: Wake Arrangements
items.text: Full setup at HDB void deck, funeral parlour or private residence — tentage, altar, Buddha image, floral arrangements, photo enlargement and nightly support.

items.title: Monk Chanting Rites
items.text: Venerable monks conduct chanting and transference-of-merit rites — at the encoffinment, nightly prayers, funeral day and cremation, per Mahayana or Theravada tradition.

items.title: Encoffinment & Embalming
items.text: Professional embalming, dressing and encoffinment performed with dignity, with a quality casket appropriate to Buddhist customs.

items.title: Cremation & Ash Collection
items.text: Booking of the cremation slot at Mandai Crematorium, hearse and family transport, and respectful ash collection the following day.

items.title: Post-Funeral Prayers
items.text: Arrangement of 7th-day (头七), 49-day (七七) and 100-day memorial prayers, guiding your loved one's journey and bringing comfort to the family.

items.title: Columbarium & Sea Burial
items.text: Guidance on niche selection at government or temple columbaria, or arrangement of sea scattering with the appropriate Buddhist ritual.

gallery.title: A serene
gallery.lead: Glimpses of the dignified arrangements and tranquil settings we prepare for every family.

rites.title: Buddhist funeral
rites.lead: Each rite carries deep meaning — generating merit for the departed and guiding them peacefully toward their next journey.

items.title: Encoffinment Rite
items.text: Monks chant as your loved one is laid into the casket, blessing the departed and sanctifying the beginning of the wake.

items.title: Nightly Chanting
items.text: Evening sutra recitations — commonly the Amitabha Sutra — transfer merit to the departed while bringing calm to the bereaved.

items.title: Funeral Day Service
items.text: The final-day rite includes prayers, last respects and the procession, conducted with solemnity before the cortege departs for cremation.

items.title: 49 Days of Prayers
items.text: In Buddhist belief, the consciousness journeys for up to 49 days. Weekly prayers, especially the 7th and 49th day, support a favourable rebirth.

packages.title: Funeral
packages.lead: Every package is complete — no hidden costs. Speak with our advisors for current pricing and customisation.

items.name: 5-Day Wake
features: Floral & fruit altar offerings refreshed daily

items.q: What should I do immediately when a loved one passes at home?
items.a: Call a doctor to certify the death (we can arrange one), then call our 24-hour hotline. Our team will take care of the transfer, documentation and all funeral arrangements from there.

items.q: Can the wake be held at an HDB void deck?
items.a: Yes. We obtain the necessary town council permit and handle the complete setup — tentage, lighting, altar, seating and nightly security — at the void deck, a funeral parlour, or your home.

items.q: Do you serve both Mahayana and Theravada traditions?
items.a: Yes. We work with venerable monks of both traditions and will arrange rites according to your family's practice and dialect group customs.

We accompany you for ash collection, then assist with your chosen resting place — a columbarium niche, sea scattering with Buddhist ritual, or other arrangements — plus the 7th-day, 49-day and 100-day prayers.
